Name: Joja Hut - Jojamo Junimo Robot Retexture
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
Introducing the Joja Hut: the Joja route-equivalent of a Junimo hut! Junimos are no longer in the Valley with Joja around, but Joja Inc. has got your crops covered!

Please note: this mod only applies when you finished the Joja Community Development Form. If you have this mod installed and are doing the Community Center route, then you will have the normal junimo huts available in Wizard’s shop.

This mod changes junimo hut textures, junimos' sprites and audio, as well as Wizard's shop price.

Vanilla junimo hut = 20,000 gold/200 stone/100 fiber/9 Starfruit
Joja hut = 30,000 gold
